# Synthetic media

synthetic-colors.mp4 contains one second of generated footage: a red left half,
a blue right half and a 330 Hz sine wave. It contains no recorded people,
accounts or production data. It is 128 by 240 pixels at 20 frames per second,
H.264 video and AAC audio. Native tests use FFmpeg tools only as independent
fixture decoders; the application renderer uses GStreamer Editing Services.
